## Legal Entity

An Account is who you sell to; a Legal Entity is who signs — registered name, entity form, jurisdiction, registration number, masked tax ID, and the authorized signatory.

### Non-goals

A Contract reaches its entities through `parties` (Legal Party Role) and its signature blocks, not through a field here. No KYC or verification workflow.
